description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources used in the AttrEval-Simulation, showing five distinct categories represented by colored slices and labeled with their respective percentages. The largest segment is blue, labeled “ENTITYQUEST” at 26.0%. The second largest is red, labeled “HOTPOTQA” at 24.2%. The third largest is orange, labeled “TRIVIAQA” at 22.7%. The fourth is yellow, labeled “POPQA” at 21.6%. The smallest segment is a thin green slice labeled “TREC” at 1.9%. A separate, very small gray bar at the top left is labeled “3.6%” but lacks a corresponding category label or slice in the pie chart. Each slice is clearly labeled with its category name and percentage value via a line extending from the slice to its text. The chart does not include a legend, and all slices are presented in their standard position without being exploded or otherwise emphasized. The segments appear to be ordered in descending size from the top right moving clockwise.
